title: When I need to prepare monthly executive reports, I want to automatically aggregate metrics from Goo
job_to_be_done: When I need to prepare monthly executive reports, I want to automatically aggregate metrics from Google Analytics, SEMrush, and HubSpot, so I can avoid 2 days of manual compilation and get consistent, timely data.
painful_workflow: Logging into each analytics tool, exporting PDFs/CSVs, copying key metrics into a PowerPoint deck, spending 2 days compiling.
current_workaround: Log into each tool, export PDFs/CSVs, copy key metrics into a PowerPoint deck, spend 2 days compiling.
verified_facts: A Marketing Analytics Manager spends approximately 2 days per month manually compiling reports from Google Analytics, SEMrush, and HubSpot (SIG-0003)
The current workaround involves logging into each tool, exporting PDFs/CSVs, and copying metrics into a PowerPoint deck (SIG-0003)
Consequences include stale data, staff burnout, inconsistent metrics, and delayed decision-making (SIG-0003)
The trigger is monthly board meeting preparation (SIG-0003)
inferences: The labor cost of this workflow is approximately $600-900/month based on typical Marketing Analytics Manager compensation (inferred from SIG-0003's 2-day estimate)
The user is likely aware of automation tools but has not adopted one, possibly due to cost, complexity, or organizational inertia (inferred from the absence of tool mentions in SIG-0003)
